# Measures at a Glance {#measures-at-a-glance}

All survey items in the study, in the order participants completed them. *Items* counts survey questions (excluding instructions, form-status fields, and attention checks); *Scored* counts variables calculated in REDCap.

```{r measures-overview, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(kableExtra)

cb <- readxl::read_xlsx("Codebook/sona_codebook.xlsx") |>
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), "", as.character(.x))),
         Order = as.integer(Order))

is_attention <- function(label) str_detect(label, regex("paying attention", ignore_case = TRUE))

overview <- cb |>
  group_by(Measure) |>
  summarise(
    first       = min(Order),
    `REDCap form` = paste(unique(Form), collapse = ", "),
    Variables   = n(),
    Items       = sum(!`Field Type` %in% c("calc", "descriptive") &
                      !str_ends(Variable, "_complete") & !is_attention(Label)),
    `Attention checks` = sum(is_attention(Label) & !`Field Type` %in% c("calc", "descriptive")),
    Scored      = sum(`Field Type` == "calc"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(first) |>
  mutate(`#` = row_number(),
         `REDCap form` = paste0("<code style='word-break:break-all;font-size:11px;'>",
                                str_replace_all(`REDCap form`, ", ", "</code><br><code style='word-break:break-all;font-size:11px;'>"),
                                "</code>")) |>
  select(`#`, Measure, `REDCap form`, Items, Scored, `Attention checks`)

overview |>
  kbl(escape = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), font_size = 12) |>
  column_spec(3, width = "18em")
```

*Exercise Questions Compiled* is a single REDCap form containing the Compulsive Exercise Test, Drive for Muscularity Scale, Exercise Dependence Scale, and the EPSI exercise/muscle-building items; those are listed as separate measures above (variables end in `_merged`).
